items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dorothy told Manford we’ll have to make this record in California, and Manford’s not about to come to California. You know, he’s really Nordic. So we started producing our own records from then on.

ctx.x: But I’ll tell you something else interesting about that: I didn’t like somebody messing with me so much about that, because that’s what I was doing. And what you are seeing is what I’m doing, and as a result, thanks to Higgins... Higgins was sick during The Water is Wide time period in the early ‘90s, and he wanted to record on his own drums near home, near his temple and stuff like that. Dorothy told Manford we’ll have to make this record in California, and Manford’s not about to come to California. You know,…
